_README: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy to extents.json and REPLACE every box.
The boxes below are rough, eyeballed approximations included to show the
shape of the file and to let the pipeline be exercised end to end. They
are NOT survey data and must not be used for a real sweep: a sloppy box
that spills into the neighbouring town produces points the geocoder
answers correctly and the scorer counts as misses, which would push a
good area below the promotion threshold.
Draw each box off satellite imagery, tight to the built-up extent.
Keys are 'City::Town' for cities WITH town data, or a bare 'City' for the
48 cities without it (those are sampled to answer city resolution only).
